Returned 6 ranked results via StructuredOutput.

Key findings for the macos-setup angle:
- The Ghostty official Features page is the authoritative confirmation that Ghostty supports the Kitty Graphics Protocol (and, by corroboration from discussions, does NOT support iTerm2 OSC 1337 inline images or Sixel — important for the "unsupported" determination).
- Discussion #3054 is the strongest practical-tool source: under Ghostty you must use `chafa -f kitty` (the `-f iterm` path silently fails because Ghostty has no sixel/iterm fallback). Ghostty is notably unusual in implementing kitty graphics without sixel.
- Discussions #7350 (PNG render bug on macOS), #8948 (icat leaves an uncleared Dock badge), and #7224 (tmux passthrough constraint) cover the macOS-specific gotchas and known limitations.
- Discussion #7743 covers font/cell-size differences (default font 13 macOS vs 12 elsewhere; DPI 72 vs 96) relevant to sizing inline images.
